== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The January restriction uses “never,” which the period rules apply even when game text is canceled. October #46a reorders the verbs and keeps the same restriction. The remaster expressly includes being carried, removes the defense-value alternative and Senate cancellation protection, prints Politics 4 as a stat and grants a Republic icon at the opponent’s Senate.
